  python: python3

    # this POSIX dev machine -- see scripts/check_import_safety.py's own

    # model (deliberately does not flip sys.platform/os.name).

    pass_filenames: false
    files: ^(repository_manager/|pyproject\.toml$)

    name: validate bumpversion config
    # B6/C2 (REMAINING-ISSUES-DESIGNS.md): this is the ONE gate in this repo
    # that already enforces version-mirror consistency (every file registered
    # in .bumpversion.cfg, via bump2version's own dry-run). Extended in place
    # -- rather than adding a second, parallel gate -- to also cover the two
    # generated lock artifacts .bumpversion.cfg was never responsible for:
    # uv.lock's own self-package version (B6: it silently drifted a full
    # major version behind pyproject.toml, because it is regenerated by
    # `uv lock`, not text-substituted by the bumper) and requirements.txt's
    # dependency ranges (C2: it drifted to pin an unpublishable
    # framework floor with nothing catching it, because the fleet's
    # version/lockfile edict only ever named uv.lock).
    entry: |-

    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    files: ^(\.bumpversion\.cfg$|pyproject\.toml$|requirements\.txt$|uv\.lock$|\.pre-commit-config\.yaml$)

    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
    always_run: true

    # which the default bootstrap does not build (bootstrap.sh --native does).
    entry: python -m pytest tests -q --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider -n auto -m "not slow and not integration and not native" --timeout=120

    pass_filenames: false
    files: ^(repository_manager/|tests/|scripts/|pyproject\.toml$|requirements\.txt$|pytest\.ini$)
